name: Xmas Bingo
ogImageAlt: Xmas Bingo: a bingo board with red-bauble numbers, a snowman and a Christmas tree on a snowy night

description.board: A Christmas bingo board for the classroom: draw the numbers 1 to 99 with jingling sounds and festive animations, then play English challenges for kids aged 7 to 10.
description.cards: Printable Xmas Bingo cards: 24 unique Christmas tombola cards on A4 sheets, ready to print and cut for the classroom.
description.answers: The answers to every Xmas Bingo English challenge, for the host.
